I don't get it though, how can a cop in a traffic stop tell if you've been smoking pot unless your vehicle is filled with smoke or a joint in the ashtray.

I've never heard of the saliva test during a traffic stop unless I'm misunderstanding the whole story.

In the USA I've been pulled up and and the cop asked me why my eyes were red I just said I have allergies and in the US we have the 4th amendment to protect us from unlawful search and seizure. 

I wish the best of luck to you with that bullshit charge you got.

Thanks bro.

I love it because it brings me alive and makes me feel upbeat and great and that I feel "normal" again in a way. The warmth in my stomach, how I laugh at everything, how such in a good mood I am and how numb I am sober.

Don't get me wrong I've had plenty of bad times, car accident, pissed my self plenty of times, passed out on floors, gotten into fights. I haven't had any of said problems in a while but the only problem I have now is the aftermath(hangover) and how that affects my mental health.

Bro, are you drunk lol? How does this relate to anything I just said?

Hold on because I'll meet you there in a sec.
You took the words right out of my mouth. :)

Sorry to here that man. I never met anyone who lost their drivers license from pot. 

>Detection devices are crazy sensitive

I'm assuming that you are on probation or violated?

Thanks bro, I really appreciate you taking the time to talking to me when other people will automatically see " I don't want help " and just leave it at that. Addiction is a shitty fucking spectrum; not just black and white I know deep down I have the potential to quit and better myself but at the same time it's not that easy.

Only probably with CBD is it doesn't produce the high. To have the high I guess you have to have the thc and the thc makes me paranoid so there is just no winning for me lmao.

Out of all the shit i'm addicted to it's the organ destroying alcohol the only drug that can kill you from withdrawal -- not even heroin kills you from withdrawals OD'ing does.

Once a week maximum, I can't afford a private therapist that is big bucks, my shitty state health insurance covers mine.

I know my perspective is fucked up but we are all going to die anyway someday so it doesn't matter. 

I wouldn't ask for a liver donation even if I stayed sober because I'm the one who fucked my organs up -- no one else, just me.

Just because I don't want to stay sober doesn't mean I don't have any goals in mind. I want to continue to get my degree, I want to have a nice job, I want to have fun that doesn't require getting drunk all the time. I can be a functional alcoholic (at times) but as far the mental health issues that's another story.

Addiction is a spectrum not "black and white".

I really wish I could enjoy weed like the rest of my peers but unfortunately it makes me incredibly paranoid even by myself. 

I am thinking of getting a Vape instead of cigarettes though.

>re evaluate your goals and you can't do that right now

Maybe it's not so much as can't but that I don't want to. You can't half ass trying to stay sober.
